reason: The one preregistered symmetric rule failed at both 1m and 5m after measured market-specific $100 execution costs and adverse funding. No parameter or market-specific retuning was performed.

hypothesis.name: FBR20-A0.25-V1-SMA20
hypothesis.entry: On a completed bar, penetrate the prior 20-bar Donchian boundary by at least 0.25 ATR14, close back inside the prior range in the reversal direction, and require volume at or above SMA20; enter at the next bar open.
hypothesis.exit: Exit at SMA20, a 1.5% safety stop, or a fixed 60-minute timeout.
hypothesis.directions: Long and Short are exact mirrors.
hypothesis.selection: One fixed rule across the same 15 markets and both 1m/5m timeframes; no parameter grid.

data.source: Gap-free native Lighter 1m candles; 5m strictly aggregated from five consecutive 1m bars
data.executionCost: Each market's measured executable full-round-trip p95
data.adverseExecution: Each market's worst observed full round trip, reported separately
